name: D3x.ai exchange spot-price manipulation
summary: The D3x exchange priced USDT/D3XAT conversions with D3XAT.price(), which returned the PancakeSwap spot quote from Router.getAmountsOut with no time-weighting or bound. In one transaction the attacker bought D3XAT from the exchange through fresh helper accounts, pumped the pool's spot price, and redeemed D3XAT against the exchange's USDT at the manipulated quote.
notes: Both the exchange implementation (trusts the quote) and the D3XAT implementation whose price() computes it from pool spot reserves carry the defect; the token proxy's upgrade to that implementation is the later reset. The later rise of a D3XAT storage limit from 10,000 to 20,000 was not needed: each helper bought 9,900.

The exchange proxy and the protocol controller 0x13342140a62cb51c052b5a70eb186f40a1725ebf (deployer, fee and tax receiver) are one victim, so the redemption fee it received cancels; the loss is the exchange's net USDT outflow to the attacker. D3XAT nets to a gain for the victim and is not a loss component.
